title: Account Credit Deposit Volume Credit on Lapsed-Year Renewals — Domain Registrations
content:
## Deposit volume terms

For a grace-period renewal of Domain Registrations billed on or after 1 December 2025, the lapsed-year volume credit, one of the lapsed-year credits of that renewal, is USD 0.50 for each renewed year where the account credit deposits posted on the customer's Harborline Customer Accounts account less than 12 whole months before the day of the renewal total USD 5000.00 or more, USD 0.25 for each renewed year where they total at least USD 250.00 but less than USD 5000.00, and nothing where they total less, a month counting only once its day of the month is reached.

### Bands

| Deposits in the window | Volume credit |
|---|---|
| USD 5000.00 or more | USD 0.50 for each renewed year |
| USD 250.00 up to USD 4999.99 | USD 0.25 for each renewed year |
| Under USD 250.00 | nothing |

Only entries that are account credit deposits count; other entries on the account credit, such as refunds or service credits, are not deposits.

### The window

A deposit counts while fewer than 12 whole months separate its posting date from the day of the renewal, and a month is whole only once its day of the month is reached.

Hypothetical dates:
- A deposit posted on 18 April 2027 still counts for a renewal on 17 April 2028: only 11 whole months have passed, the twelfth not being complete until 18 April.
- For a renewal on 18 April 2028 the same deposit no longer counts: 12 whole months have passed.

### Boundary cases (hypothetical totals)

- Deposits in the window total exactly USD 5000.00: USD 0.50.
- They total USD 4999.99: USD 0.25.
- They total exactly USD 250.00: USD 0.25.
- They total USD 249.99: nothing.
